description: This file defines a class for a dashed line style in the Image_Graph library, an object-oriented PHP graph rendering utility. It extends a formatted line class to implement dashed line patterns with specific dash and space colors.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Line_Dashed
classes.description: A class representing a dashed line style, inheriting from Image_Graph_Line_Formatted, generating dashed lines with specified dash and space colors.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Line_Dashed
methods.description: Constructor for the dashed line class, initializing the dash pattern with two colors for dashes and spaces.
